=== tool
{
  "tool": "codex_send",
  "description": "Send a part of this session's work (a plan step, a diff, a finding, your last answer) to the Codex CLI session paired with it (the codex-inbox context), for Codex to validate, to take as context, or to answer a question about. Only when the user asks for it. Needs a paired Codex session: without one it fails, and the user pairs from Codex. Codex's answer comes back later as the codex-review context (a validate's wakes you): don't wait or poll. Never send secrets or the whole conversation.",
  "params": {
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "validate",
        "context",
        "question"
      ],
      "required": true,
      "description": "validate: check this part and answer with a verdict; context: for Codex to know, no answer expected; question: answer the question in text"
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "required": true,
      "description": "A short one-line title for the part; Codex's answer names it"
    },
    "text": {
      "type": "string",
      "required": true,
      "description": "The part itself and what to check or ask, as Codex should read it; name the files, functions or diff range to look at. A long text goes to a file Codex reads"
    }
  },
  "label": "sent to Codex",
  "preview": "validate: cache step 2"
}
=== command
{
  "command": "/codex",
  "description": "the paired Codex session: status; validate|context <text>, last: send to it; install-skill: install Codex's chi-peer skill",
  "anytime": true
}
=== annotation
{
  "annotation": "Confirm with Codex",
  "command": "/codex validate"
}
=== peer_source
{
  "peer_source": "codex-review",
  "label": "Codex"
}
=== hook
{
  "hook": "before_turn",
  "priority": 100
}
=== hook
{
  "hook": "after_turn",
  "priority": 100
}
=== USAGE
usage: /codex — whether a Codex session is paired; /codex validate <text> | context <text> — send the text to it; /codex last — send the last answer as context; /codex install-skill — install Codex's chi-peer skill, which pairs
